content: The Diabetes Risk Test, as outlined by the American Diabetes Association (ADA), assigns points based on age to assess an individual's risk for diabetes. If you are under 40 years of age, you receive 0 points. If you are between 40 and 49 years of age, you are assigned 1 point. If you are between 50 and 59 years of age, you are assigned 2 points. If you are 60 years of age or older, you are assigned 3 points.
